PB_SEQUENCE: injuries
Every warrior taken out of action rolls on the Serious Injuries chart: Heroes a D66, Henchmen a D6.
experience
Heroes and Henchmen groups gain experience for the battle, with the underdog bonus; then any advance rolls.
exploration
One D6 for each Hero not taken out of action, one more for a win; the total gives the shards found, doubles or better an unusual location.
wyrdstone
Sell wyrdstone once per sequence; the price is for the whole lot and depends on the size of the warband.
veterans
Roll 2D6: the experience of the veterans available for hire this round.
rare
A Hero not taken out of action may look for one rare item (2D6 against its rarity); what he finds goes into the stash.
dramatis
Look for a Dramatis Persona if you want to hire one.
recruits
Hire new recruits with their free dagger and buy common items, in any order and as often as you like.
equipment
Swap equipment between models as you wish, provided they may use it.
rating
Update the warband rating. You are ready to fight again.

PB_ARTEFACTS: The Boots and Rope of Pieter
The wearer moves normally on any terrain, including vertical surfaces, adding horizontal and vertical distance with no Initiative test (except across gaps).
A dagger treated as a sword; opponents it wounds are stunned on 1-3 (Undead knocked down) and put out of action on 4-6.
Gromril armour with three runes: immune to spells, moves through solid objects, one extra wound (even above the racial maximum).
An Elven bow that always hits on 2+, arrows count as hunting arrows, any enemy in sight may be picked, Dwarfs draw its arrows; it cannot shoot Elves.
The wearer is always frenzied, +1 Strength in close combat, never leaves combat, and attacks stunned or knocked-down models nearby, even his own side.
The bearer sees all models, rolls two dice after the battle on the Exploration chart (pick one), and has an extra 6+ save against shooting and close combat.
